NO UNIVERSAL CONSTANT FOR UNBIASED AVERAGE-OUTPUT MOMENT COST
2026-10-09. Separate parameterized addendum; no new tuple scan.

Origin and status. The coordinator requested this direct family
consequence of this worker's frozen five-Clifford Cauchy proof. The
argument below is an independent analytic reconstruction of that
consequence. Literature priority is UNVERIFIED. This falsifies a route
lemma with arbitrarily inflated trace budget, not the original legal
common-EB Dirichlet gate.

EXACT STATEMENT

For every integer q>=2, choose any finite-dimensional traceless Hermitian
Clifford generators Gamma_1,...,Gamma_q satisfying
  Gamma_i Gamma_j+Gamma_j Gamma_i=2 delta_ij I_d.
Let A_i=Gamma_i, L=qI_d, Y=(q-1)I_d, and take the legal product-tracial
Choi state R=tau_d tensor tau_d tensor tau_d, tau_d=I_d/d. Thus Phi is
the depolarizing channel and the supplied broadcaster outputs tau_d
tensor tau_d on every input. Its marginal Phi is unital, TP,
HS-self-adjoint and entanglement breaking. R has full support and all
the required symmetries and marginals.

On BC put
  M_i=(Gamma_i tensor I+I tensor Gamma_i)/2,
  rho_BC=I_(d^2)/d^2.
For EVERY POVM {F_z} and real labels x_z with finite second moment,
  D_i=sum_z x_(zi) F_z=M_i,
  N=sum_z ||x_z||^2 F_z,
one has
  Tr(rho_BC N)>=q^2/4,                       (A1)
while the available frame energy is V=Tr(L)/d=q. The same conclusion
holds for general outcome spaces by replacing sums with integrals.

Since q is arbitrary, for each proposed finite constant K choose q>4K.
Then no such unbiased POVM or commuting dilation can satisfy
  Tr(rho_BC N)<=K V.
Consequently no dimension-free constant-cost lemma retaining these exact
unshrunk first moments can prove even a nonsharp gate via this route.

EXISTENCE OF THE EXACT FAMILY

For q=2m on d=2^m, an explicit choice is, for j=1,...,m,
  Gamma_(2j-1)=Z^(tensor(j-1)) tensor X tensor I^(tensor(m-j)),
  Gamma_(2j)=Z^(tensor(j-1)) tensor Y tensor I^(tensor(m-j)).
The Pauli relations prove the Clifford identities directly. Every
generator is traceless. Taking the first q generators on
d=2^ceil(q/2) gives a representation for every integer q>=2. Hence
the quantified sequence needs no representation-theoretic import or
external existence premise.

For every real u, anticommutation gives
  (sum_i u_i Gamma_i)^2=||u||^2 I_d.

EXACT LEGAL OBSTRUCTION TO AVERAGE-OUTPUT QUADRATIC MOMENT DILATION
2026-10-09. Owner: quadratic_dilation_sol. No descendants or source edits.

STATUS
The universal finite-C arbitrary-frame gate remains UNKNOWN. This report
proves a counterexample to a precise two-output dilation lemma, not a
counterexample to that gate. The counterexample uses exact matrices and a
legal supplied broadcaster. A smaller unrestricted operator-positivity
shortcut is also false. These are analytic proofs, with exact finite matrix
identities independently replayed by exact_replay.py; no SDP premise.

1. EXACT INTERFACE AND THE DILATION LEMMA THAT WOULD SUFFICE

For traceless Hermitian A_1,...,A_r in M_d, put L=sum_i A_i^2 and
V=Tr(L)/d. A Hermitian Y is dual-admissible if
  L-Y-2 sum_i x_i A_i+||x||^2 I >= 0             (1)
for every real x. Its objective is tau(Y)=Tr(Y)/d.

For a normalized legal tripartite Choi state R with all single marginals
I/d, BC-swap symmetry and an HS-self-adjoint marginal channel, define
  M_i=(A_i^B+A_i^C)/2,
  H=L_A^T+(L_B+L_C)/2-2 sum_i A_i^T M_i.
The sharp desired gate is tau(Y)<=Tr(RH) for every admissible Y and legal R.

Here is a natural genuinely two-output replacement for scalar
substitution. Given A and legal R, seek ONE POVM {F_z} on BC and real
labels x_z satisfying
  sum_z F_z=I, F_z>=0,
  D_i:=sum_z x_{zi}F_z=M_i for every i,
  N:=sum_z ||x_z||^2 F_z,
  Tr(rho_BC N)<=V, where rho_BC=Tr_A R.        (MD)
One may allow general outcome spaces with finite second moments; all
arguments below use integrals in the same way. By the spectral theorem,
a commuting self-adjoint dilation N_i with an isometric compression
N_i -> M_i yields precisely such POVM first and second moments. The d=3
argument below also permits equality of the first-moment columns on the
reference support. Mere equality of doubly compressed operators is weaker
and is treated separately below. The d=4 refinement has full reference
support and therefore removes this distinction.

Why (MD) would prove the gate: integrate the positive matrix polynomial
(1), with the coefficient matrices on A transposed, against the positive
effects F_z. This gives the positive operator
  K=(L-Y)_A^T+N-2 sum_i A_i^T D_i >=0.
